# P32.3 — Repair role semantics and conservative organization identity

PR **#TBD** · base `devin/p32-2-typed-claims-and-capture-bindings` · branch
`devin/p32-3-roles-counts-and-organization-identity` · run
`implement-spec spec=docs/tickets/163_P32.3__roles-counts-and-organization-identity.md live_verification=false`
(full rigor) · BUILD_INDEX row 163 · stream **S1** — Round 10.

## Requirement ids

**SIG-TRUST-003**, **SIG-TRUST-004** (§55); cites **BL-058**. **ADR-122**.

## Summary

Three repairs land together: (1) a **canonical organisation-role taxonomy** so a source's
publisher/host label can never masquerade as an operator/owner/vendor relationship — the
OSM-contributor case — while an authoritative operator field still mints `camera_operator`;
(2) **scope-qualified count comparability** so `299 metro` and `~90+100 city` are a scope
mismatch, never a contradiction, and approximate roll-ups are labelled derived (L4, never an
observation); (3) **conservative organization identity** — name-only mints key under
`sig.org.name_scoped` (`jur:<j>|<name>` evidenced, else `src:<s>|<name>`) as unmerged
`candidate=True` organisations, identical names across jurisdictions NEVER auto-union, and only
strong same-scope external ids (UEI/LEI/DUNS/CAGE/agency-code) join.

- **`db/`** — new `organization_roles.py` (the single `OrganizationRole` taxonomy +
  `ROLE_OF_PREDICATE` + `mints_entity_ref` every consumer shares); `EntityRef` carries
  `jurisdiction`/`scope`/`candidate`/`role` into the immutable `identity_basis`;
  `identity_guard` adds `PARTNER_NAME_SCOPED_SCHEME`; `PgClaimSink.register_vocabulary`
  pre-registers qualifier-only ids (`count_scope`, `count_scope_detail`, `evidence_origin`);
  sqitch **`partner_org_scoped_identity_key`** (deploy/revert/verify; backfill-only — legacy
  `sig.org.name` keys are preserved for audit, never re-keyed).
- **`resolution/`** — `partner_identity` mints scoped-name candidates with the minting role on
  the ref; per-row `partner_jurisdiction`/`partner_scope`/`partner_crosswalk`; the generic
  "Federal Emergency Management Agency" refusal (P31.13) is unchanged. New
  **`partner_name_audit`** + `sig-resolution partner-name-audit --dsn …` — the read-only dry-run
  impact report: every legacy `sig.org.name` key, its asserting sources/predicates, the scoped
  keys it decomposes into, and its split count.
- **`reconcile/`** — `count_scope.py` (`CountScope`, three-way `compare_scope`,
  `partition_by_scope`, `scope_from_qualifiers`, `DerivedApproximateSum`); resolution partitions
  admissible claims by scope — per-scope winners, `SCOPE_MIXED` (not a contradiction) +
  `clarify_count_scope` research task when scopes mix; cross-scope `UnresolvedDelta` subtraction
  suppressed; `derive_approximate_sum` refuses undeclared/mixed/indistinguishable
  sub-populations; ruleset `2026.2` adds `UNRESOLVED_SCOPE_MIXED`; qualifiers read through
  materialization.
- **`connectors/`** — `dot_511` writes `camera_registry_publisher` (provenance, mints no ref) for
  the `agency` label and `camera_operator` only from `operator_fields`; `audit_structural`
  twins refs under source scope + the `access` role; every `partner_ref_rows` caller passes
  `scope=ctx.source.id`.
- **`inference/`** — accountability legs derive from the role taxonomy; module-load assert: no
  provenance-role predicate can enter `ACCOUNTABILITY_PREDICATES`.
- **`ontology/`** — new `camera_registry_publisher` predicate + `count_scope`/
  `count_scope_detail`/`evidence_origin` qualifier predicates; `template`/`subscription`/
  `recommendation` genres (D6 — non-probative — for every predicate); regenerated committed.
- **`ops/seed.py`** — honest count scopes, labelled derived `~190`,
  `evidence_origin=seed_fixture` stamped, qualifier vocabulary registered first; ODbL
  compartment untouched.
- **Read surfaces** — API models/routes/store expose `count_scope`/`count_scope_detail`/
  `count_scope_jurisdiction`/`evidence_origin`; the dossier carries `scope_label` and renders a
  scope-partitioned resolution without a phantom winner.
- **Acceptance** — the OKC slice now carries metro vs city-limits scopes, the same-scope
  `299` vs `~300` contradiction stays, and the `~190` derived sum is labelled.
